C9000252.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 252 (A torsion-free hyperbolic group that is neither residually finite nor linear over any field.; papers: A torsion-free hyperbolic group that is not residually finite; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/252.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

Q_OBSTRUCTION.statement: For fixed admissible punctured-line data satisfying the strict budget, no finite-group assignment satisfying the triangular factorizations makes every rectangular word nonidentity; q may divide the group order.
Q_OBSTRUCTION.review_note: Complete universal prose proof submitted for independent review; this is not a kernel claim.

Q_TRACE.statement: Regular permutation block arrays whose rectangular words are nonidentity have first Gram trace r^2 D and second Gram trace (2r^3-r^2)D, hence real rank at least r^2 D/(2r-1).

Q_REDUCTION.statement: Every integer matrix of squared row norms at most r has rank over F_q at least half its real rank whenever q is prime and q>r.
Q_REDUCTION.review_note: The strict half-rank comparison is proved using Hadamard and integer-minor divisibility; this argument is not formalized in Main.lean.

Q_LOCAL.statement: Summing the shifted L-inverse R products over a Cartesian block factors the entire rD by rD matrix through D dimensions, without commuting the factors.

Q_INTERPOLATION.statement: Distinct grid marks and 2h(|S|-1)<q-1 yield rank-one weights H with H(a_i)=E_ii and sum over each punctured line equal to -E_ii.

Q_TENSOR.statement: The punctured-line sums imply the negative direct-sum tensor identity, whose rank bounds contradict Nr/4>2|P|+r|E|.
Q_TENSOR.source_locator: construction.tex, eq:tensor-certificate and final rank comparison

Q_PRODUCT.statement: For a finite family of words, if no finite quotient preserves them all, some fixed member is killed by every finite-group homomorphism.

Q_FORMAL_CORE.statement: Universal regular permutation laws and expanded trace sums, noncommutative shifted Cartesian factorization, constructed interpolation tensor certificate over every finite field, and finite-product quantifier; excludes the rank arguments.
Q_FORMAL_CORE.review_note: Official Lean 4.31.0 evidence derives closed_kernel for this core claim only, exit_code=0 and proof_holes=[]. Independent statement-fidelity review remains required.

Q_BUDGET_EXTENSION.statement: With all the same non-budget assumptions, the obstruction also holds under the weak inequality Nr/4 >= 2|P|+r|E|, because each nonzero integer array has strictly greater than half its real rank after reduction.
Q_BUDGET_EXTENSION.review_note: A mathematical strengthening relative to the staged statement; novelty and significance have not been independently assessed.

Q_RESIDUAL.statement: With admissible incidence data and nonidentity rectangular words established, the constructed group has nontrivial finite residual.

Q_INCIDENCE.statement: For sufficiently large primes q the manuscript's alteration supplies the stated incidence data and strict budget.

Q_GEOMETRY.statement: The triangle complex is torsion-free hyperbolic and every specified rectangular word is nonidentity.
Q_GEOMETRY.source_locator: construction.tex, thm:triangle-complex, lem:links, eq:rectangles; geometry-foundations.tex and geometry-thinness.tex
